result.reason: The clause meets or exceeds the preferred limits: statutory workers’ compensation, CGL at $1M per occurrence/$2M aggregate, and at least $5M covering E&O and cyber, with certificates available on request. However, it unnecessarily raises E&O from $2M to $5M, requires cyber coverage regardless of whether Contractor processes Customer Data, and adds insurer-rating, additional-insured, waiver-of-subrogation, primary/non-contributory, cancellation-notice, and non-limitation terms not required by the playbook. The combined E&O/cyber formulation may also obscure whether separate limits apply, and the added language creates an awkward, overlong sentence and duplicative material-change notice obligations.
